<!-- Perspective view of the webinar’s polar frontier. The two probes use the same radius (286); the training corpus has radius 158. -->
<figure id="knowledge-frontier" class="mfm-frontier">
  <figcaption>
    <strong>Knowledge expands unevenly</strong>
    <span>Two unseen cases at the same distance from the training corpus can land on opposite sides of the frontier.</span>
  </figcaption>
  <div class="mfm-frontier__stage">

      <title id="frontier-figure-title">An uneven knowledge frontier in three dimensions</title>
      <desc id="frontier-figure-description">An irregular raised surface surrounds the region covered by the training corpus. A dashed ring connects two unseen cases at the same distance from this region. Case A lands inside the frontier, in a direction where the surface extends farther. Case B lands outside it.</desc>
